== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original, [[Blaster Scope (PC Errata)]], and [[Blaster Scope (PC Errata 2)]]. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member article. Columns are Original, PC Errata, and PC Errata 2 only. No Unlimited, Japanese, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the wording that changed. Glossary 2.0 intermediate (<code>your Imperial Blaster or Blaster Rifle</code>) has no distinct article and is not a column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
